answer: A photonic attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by forcing agents to compute matrix tasks on optical chips lit by a saffron laser. Instead of virtualizing free nodes, an attacker must buy dedicated photonic hardware mounted on vibration-isolated basalt benches for each identity. Validators verify agent responses by checking the phase delta across interference channels. However, thermal drift in the waveguides can distort optical phase, falsely invalidating legitimate agents.
